_source: FAQs for Contact Us (PRF-006, DAT-008: at least 15 across 5 topics)

faqs.question: How do I track my order?
faqs.answer: Go to Profile › Orders and open the order. The timeline shows every step, and tracking details appear once the order ships.

faqs.question: Can I cancel my order?
faqs.answer: You can cancel items while the order is Placed, Confirmed or Packed. Once it ships, cancellation isn't available, but you can return eligible items after delivery.

faqs.question: What is the delivery OTP?
faqs.answer: Every order has a 4-digit OTP in its order details from Out for Delivery. Share it with the delivery person to receive your order.

faqs.question: My payment failed. Was I charged?
faqs.answer: No money is taken when a payment fails, is cancelled or times out. You can retry from the order for 15 minutes without rebuilding your bag.

faqs.question: Which payment methods can I use?
faqs.answer: Card, UPI, gift card, credits and cash on delivery. Credits and one gift card can be combined with one other method.

faqs.question: How does the HDFC Bank offer work?
faqs.answer: Pay with an HDFC Bank credit or debit card to get 10% off eligible items, up to ₹1,000, when eligible items total ₹2,500 or more.

faqs.question: Can I use real card details?
faqs.answer: No. This is a demo store — use the test cards listed on the Demo help page. Real cards are not accepted.

faqs.question: How do I return an item?
faqs.answer: Open the order, choose the item and select Return. Pick a reason and confirm. You'll see the return status and pickup details.

faqs.question: Which items can't be returned?
faqs.answer: Innerwear, lingerie, beauty and personal care, and baby care items. The product page shows whether an item is returnable.

faqs.question: Where will my refund go?
faqs.answer: Back to the original payment method — card or UPI first, then gift card, then credits. Cash on delivery refunds are paid as credits.

faqs.question: I forgot my password. What do I do?
faqs.answer: Use Forgot password. Enter your email or phone, choose your security question and answer it, then set a new password.

faqs.question: How do I delete my account?
faqs.answer: Raise an Account deletion request from Contact Us. Accounts inactive for 30 days are also deleted automatically.

faqs.question: Why was my account locked?
faqs.answer: After 5 incorrect attempts, sign-in is paused for 15 minutes to protect your account. Try again after that.

faqs.question: Is delivery free?
faqs.answer: Yes, when your bag value after discounts and coupon is above ₹1,999. Otherwise a ₹99 delivery charge applies.

faqs.question: How do I find my size?
faqs.answer: Open the size guide on the product page for measurements. If you're between sizes, the guide suggests which to pick.

faqs.question: What are credits and gift cards?
faqs.answer: Credits are shopping balance in your account — new accounts get ₹500. Gift cards are redeemed by code in Profile › Gift Cards and used at payment.
